title: TCF21-WNT5A axis drives metastasis of colorectal cancer via stromal-tumor cell communication.
authors: Huang, Qingxing; Ren, Aigang; Cui, Xiaolong; Tian, Dianfeng; Liu, Hui; Wang, Liwei; Cao, Aihong
one_liner_zh: 该文通过scRNA-seq和bulk RNA-seq研究结直肠癌肝转移中TCF21-WNT5A轴，属于肿瘤转移机制与表达分析，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: The third most prevalent form of cancer, colorectal cancer (CRC), is associated with a high mortality rate due to colorectal liver metastases (CRLM). However, the molecular mechanisms underlying CRLM remain poorly understood. METHODS: ScRNA-seq data and Bulk RNA-seq data were collected from GEO database. First, we screened genes that showed differentially expression in three groups of colorectal tissues (normal vs. primary tumor vs. metastases). We then performed machine learning to identify signature genes involved in colorectal cancer. We further investigated the expression patterns of these core genes at the single-cell level. Through the integration of single-cell and bulk RNA-seq data, we have identified pivotal genes linked to CRC liver metastasis. Furthermore, we revealed that TCF21 is overexpressed in colorectal tumor tissues with metastases using clinical samples and HCT116 cells. RESULTS: We have identified 12 pivotal genes linked to CRC liver metastasis, which aims to dissect the molecular underpinnings of colorectal cancer and pave the way for novel therapeutic targets in clinical practice. Using scRNA-seq analysis, our findings revealed unique cellular communication features in CRC metastasis. Besides, TCF21(high) stromal cells were mainly enriched in metastatic tissues and TCF21 RNA level is associated with CRC metastasis, indicating vital role of TCF21 in CRC. Mechanistically, TCF21 regulates the expression of WNT5A and overexpression of WNT5A could reverse the effect of TCF21 deficiency in CRC. CONCLUSIONS: We identified 12 signature hub genes associated with CRLM by using both scRNA-seq and bulk RNA-seq analysis. Further, we revealed the vital role of TCF21, which promotes CRLM by regulating WNT5A in CRC metastasis. The revelations have illuminated the pivotal function of the TCF21-WNT5A pathway in the development of colorectal cancer, indicating possible avenues for therapeutic intervention aimed at preventing and managing the spread of CRC.
abstract_zh: 引言：结直肠癌（colorectal cancer, CRC）是第三种最常见的癌症形式，其高死亡率与结直肠肝转移（colorectal liver metastases, CRLM）相关。然而，CRLM背后的分子机制仍知之甚少。方法：从GEO数据库收集了单细胞RNA测序（ScRNA-seq）数据和批量RNA测序（Bulk RNA-seq）数据。首先，我们筛选了在三组结直肠组织（正常组织 vs. 原发肿瘤 vs. 转移灶）中差异表达的基因。随后，我们采用机器学习方法识别参与结直肠癌的特征基因。我们进一步在单细胞水平上研究了这些核心基因的表达模式。通过整合单细胞和批量RNA测序数据，我们识别出与CRC肝转移相关的关键基因。此外，我们利用临床样本和HCT116细胞揭示，TCF21在伴有转移的结直肠肿瘤组织中过表达。结果：我们识别出12个与CRC肝转移相关的关键基因，旨在解析结直肠癌的分子基础，并为临床实践中的新型治疗靶点铺平道路。通过单细胞RNA测序分析，我们的发现揭示了CRC转移中独特的细胞通讯特征。此外，TCF21高表达（TCF21(high)）的基质细胞主要富集于转移组织中，且TCF21 RNA水平与CRC转移相关，表明TCF21在CRC中发挥重要作用。机制上，TCF21调控WNT5A的表达，而WNT5A的过表达可逆转CRC中TCF21缺失的影响。结论：我们通过结合单细胞RNA测序和批量RNA测序分析，识别出12个与CRLM相关的特征枢纽基因。进一步，我们揭示了TCF21的关键作用，其通过调控WNT5A促进CRC转移中的CRLM。这些发现阐明了TCF21-WNT5A通路在结直肠癌发展中的核心功能，为旨在预防和管理CRC扩散的治疗干预提供了可能途径。
